note: Added after N-P10 showed that $SYSTEM.Process.Terminate runs %OnClose. N-P18 checks the abnormal end where no ObjectScript runs in the victim (OS SIGKILL).

N-P18.claim: When a process holding an object and an open transaction is killed with SIGKILL, %OnClose does not run and IRIS still rolls back its open transaction; the instance keeps accepting transactions.

closed.source: no ObjectScript runs in a SIGKILLed process
